summary: Umpqua NF point 3 miles NW of Red Cinder Butte, Douglas County, OR: a 1933 30-foot L-4 tower removed in 1961; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 14-by-14 L-4 hip-roof cab on a 30-foot round timber pole tower
facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1961 (register and Oregon lookouts page) or destroyed (firelookout.com); no source describes what remains at the site

events.note: 14-by-14 L-4 cab on a 30-foot round timber tower

evidence.supports: built 1933 on a minor point 3 miles NW of Red Cinder Butte; 30-foot L-4 tower; removed 1961
evidence.quote: Built in 1933 atop a minor point 3 miles northwest of Red Cinder Butte, this 30' pole L-4 tower was removed in 1961.

evidence.supports: 1933 14-by-14 L-4 hip-roof lookout house on a 30-foot round timber tower
evidence.quote: 1933: A 14 x 14 L-4 hip roof lookout house erected atop a 30-foot round timber tower.

evidence.supports: August 1933 road crew to build access to the new station, spelled Kelsey Point
evidence.quote: The crew will build a road to the new lookout station being built at Kelsey Point, where the forest service will maintain a primary lookout for fireman's station.

evidence.supports: photograph captioned 1941 exists; caption does not describe remains
evidence.quote: Kelsay Valley Point Lookout 1941 - courtesy of Ron Kemnow collection

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the Oregon lookouts page say the lookout was removed in 1961; firelookout.com says destroyed. The story uses both words.

The 1933 News-Review item quoted on the Oregon lookouts page spells the station Kelsey Point; the register and firelookout.com use Kelsay Valley Point. Treated as the same station because the Oregon lookouts page files the quote under this site.

sources.title: Kelsay Valley Point Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Built and removal dates agree across three sources; the open gap is what remains at the site today, which no source read describes. The 1933 name spelling (Kelsey vs Kelsay) is flagged in resolved_conflicts. No access information was found.
